title: origanum vulgare var. prismaticum
intro: Origanum vulgare var. prismaticum, commonly known as Prickly Oregano, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family, characterized by its distinctive prickly leaves and stems. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce skin irritation, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Prickly Oregano include its ability to act as an antiseptic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for treating respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. Prickly Oregano contains bioactive constituents such as rosmarinic acid, thymol, and carvacrol, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
